reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: App , website, email and phone number for this momentum camera are bogus. No customer service. Camera won’t update, app says it’s updating.

reviews.title: No longer supporting app
reviews.text: They are no longer supporting the app. It has stopped working. Emails to support just get returned as undeliverable.  They are still taking money. They should remove this app for the store.

reviews.title: Something fishy
reviews.text: The app has shut off our subscription the customer support does not work and the frequently asked questions link takes you to a website that is in Chinese and has something to do with tobacco and gambling

reviews.title: Pairing problems
reviews.text: I used the camera a couple years ago and I had no problem getting it to pair and hook up. This year I’ve tried to hook it up and it takes forever for it to even pair. Half the time it doesn’t want to pair. I finally get it to pair and I then follow the steps and right when I go to choose a plan the whole app crashes. It’s been doing the same thing every time. Don’t know if it’s outdated or what but I’m not impressed.
